initial_failures.production_issue: Accepted action IDs alone did not bind entry, tip or tool to actual observed actions.
initial_failures.resolution: Final helper requires exact ordered accepted IDs, source/voxel/frame/projection, tool identity and dimensions, and exact encoded observation geometry; no tolerance-based geometry matching.
